fields.reason: The paper reports that the RAG pipeline has a higher unsupported-answer rate (40.2%) than the closed-book model (33.5%), contradicting the abstract's claim that retrieval reduces hallucinations, and thus does not report the expected positive comparison of retrieval-augmented vs. non-retrieval performance.

selector.exact: On HistoryQuest, the RAG pipeline reaches 27.4% unsupported-answer rate. Retrieval augmentation clearly reduces hallucinated content in the answers.
